name: shopease-ecommerce-root
description: ShopEase Full Stack E-Commerce Web Application (React + Spring Boot 3.3.x)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run admin"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build

author: ShopEase Team
